text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "Did you see that, Trainer?! That was an undeniable, glorious victory!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a splendid victory.
Yeah, that was a brilliant victory.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I knew you'd definitely win!
Even before the race started, I was totally sure of it!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You too, right, Trainer? You knew we were gonna win, didn't ya?
choice_data_list: Whether you can win or not comes down to a lot of factors—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Well, of course it is.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Still, don't you sometimes get a sudden flash of certainty that has nothing to do with all that?!
choice_data_list: I'm absolutely certain you can achieve your dream!
I have absolute faith that you can achieve your dream!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haha, ahaha! That's right. You can definitely count on me for that!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me! I'll definitely keep winning,
next time, and the time after that too!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's keep pushing forward with this momentum!
Yeah, let's keep charging forward with this momentum!
Still, let's make sure to review thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I have no intention of stopping!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want them to watch me win.
Because there are things that can only be conveyed
by doing just that!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No, that's just like you, Trainer.
Cautious, or maybe I should say earnest—
choice_data_list: Because it's necessary to keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I see! If you say so, Trainer, then it must be true!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Let's start reviewing right now
so that we can keep on winning!
